from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single judgment document to support classification."""
    title: str = Field(description="The document title as written in the text, e.g., '《判决文书 1》'")
    case_indicators: list[str] = Field(description="Key phrases indicating the case nature or subject matter, e.g., '执行异议', '国家赔偿法', '管辖权异议'")
    legal_basis: list[str] = Field(description="Laws or regulations explicitly cited in the document, e.g., '国家赔偿法', '民事诉讼法'")
    document_type: str = Field(description="The type of legal document, e.g., '判决书', '裁定书', '决定书'")
    parties_relationship: str = Field(description="Description of the parties involved, e.g., '平等主体间', '公民 vs 行政机关', '公诉机关 vs 被告人'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
